decisions.quote: Where our statistics diverge, we have included the authors' findings below in parentheses. We stress, though, that these differences are minor (i.e., these are essentially the same results).
decisions.reason: Re-running the original 2004 GSS data and syntax reproduced Table B1's parameters and degrees of freedom with only minor numerical differences in log-likelihood and BIC that the authors explicitly judge to be essentially the same results.

decisions.quote: Taken together, these results show that non-sparse versions of the underlying model neither fit the data nor confirm the presence of four varieties of American nationalism.
decisions.location: Section 7 (Testing Theoretically Similar, Non-Sparse Models), p. 348
decisions.reason: The authors conduct extensive postestimation fit diagnostics and test 385 alternative non-sparse model specifications on the same data, concluding that the models fail to support the original claim of four varieties of American nationalism.
